text:
Priya (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Altara private VPC onboarding thread. Quick check: primary blockers we've flagged are KMS key cross-account access, audit log forwarding (Splunk), and egress IP requirements. Can we sync at 11am PT to confirm next steps? :wave:

Jonas (Network Eng): SGTM. Can you drop the VPC CIDR + whether they want TGW/peering? I need to map route tables and NAT config. Also do they expect static egress IPs?

Ravi (Altara): Hey! Altara details: VPC CIDR 10.10.0.0/16. Prefer Transit Gateway attachment to our infra (multi-account). Egress should come from a small set of static IPs (we have firewall allowlist). Splunk HEC at splunk://ingest.altara-corp.example:9997 (TLS). KMS key will be in Altara account; we'll invite Redwood principal.

Linh (Security): Thanks Ravi. For KMS we need the key ARN + the IAM principals (role ARNs) you will grant Encrypt/Decrypt to. Also want CloudTrail configured to send management events to the central logging account with S3 bucket encrypted and object lock disabled. Can you share target S3 bucket ARN?

Ravi (Altara): S3 bucket arn:aws:s3:::altara-cloudtrail-logs-prod. We'll add a bucket policy for Redwood write. For principals, we'll give role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Servicer. Will that be enough?

Jonas (Network Eng): Role ARN looks fine. One ask: for TGW attachment, Redwood needs a VPC acceptance IAM flow — I'll list required account IDs in the meeting. If they want static egress, we should provision NAT gateways behind an EIP pool or use egress proxy (preferred for cost). Quick config snippet for egress proxy endpoint we use:

```
# example egress proxy ALB -> NAT proxy target
Listener: 443 -> target-group: egp-proxy-tg
Target: ec2:egress-proxy (ASG)
SecurityGroup: allow inbound 443 from VPC
```

Priya (CSM): Action items so far:
- Ravi: share KMS key ARN + confirm Redwood role list (Ravi)
- Jonas: prepare TGW attachment checklist + egress design options (Jonas)
- Linh: provide CloudTrail/S3 policy template and minimum audit retention (Linh)
We'll confirm in the 11am PT call. :calendar:

audit-bot: Runbook: Private Deploy onboarding checklist updated — https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/priv-deploy-onboard (auto-post)

Ravi (Altara): Added KMS ARN in DM. Also one more constraint: our compliance team requires KMS key rotation frequency <= 90 days and key deletion disabled. Expect a short review window for key policies.

Linh (Security): Rotation <=90d OK. We'll need the KMS policy to deny deletion and require multi-factor for sensitive role changes. I'll post a template after the call.

Jonas (Network Eng): For TGW note — Redwood dedicated pools can attach to customer TGW with peering or via VPC endpoint; I'll call out latency/cost tradeoffs in the call. :thumbsup:

Priya (CSM): Great progress. Last thing — renewal risk flag: customer mentioned compliance review cycles next quarter; we should track this as a potential rollout delay. I'll add to account health notes and follow up with PM for priority. Meeting in 15.

Ravi (Altara): Thanks everyone. See you on the call.

Jonas (Network Eng): +1, prepping topology diagram.

Linh (Security): I'll draft KMS & CloudTrail policy snippets and upload to the runbook thread after the meeting.
